d: Iron Chef Susur Lee returns to the Iron Chef Canada kitchen Stadium to take on challenger Danny 'Smiles' Francis in a battle of pork.
Iron Chef Anna Olson faces challenger Chef Laura White in a seasonal showdown that’s all about holiday nuts.
Iron Chef Hugh Acheson returns to the kitchen stadium to face challenger Chef Brandon Olsen and a battle over arctic char.
Iron Chef Canada returns with an intense battle between Iron Chef Susur Lee and challenger Chef Stefan Hartmann, featuring the off-cuts of meat known as offal.
Iron Chef Lynn Crawford faces Indigenous cuisine specialist Chef Shane Chartrand in an epic showdown featuring trout.
Iron Chef Hugh Acheson takes on challenger Chef Nick Hodge as they battle over goat.
Iron Chef Amanda Cohen takes on challenger Chef Duncan Ly in a battle involving egg.
Iron Chef Rob Feenie goes head-to-head with challenger Chef Ivana Raca in battle featuring cheddar cheese.
Iron Chef Susur Lee returns to the Iron Chef Canada Kitchen Stadium to take on challenger Chef Paul Boehmer in an epic battle featuring tiny fish.
Iron Chef Lynn Crawford takes on challenger Chef Scott Vivian as they tackle bacon.
Iron Chef Amanda Cohen takes on challenger Chef Jonathan Gushue from the famed Fogo Island Inn in a battle involving squash.
Iron Chef Rob Feenie returns to Kitchen Stadium to go head-to-head with challenger Chef Fisun Ercan in Battle Beef.
Iron Chef Susur Lee returns to Kitchen Stadium to take on a chef who has been his friend and admired colleague for over twenty years, Chef Pino Posteraro.
Ready, Set, SHOWDOWN! Fourteen junior chefs enter the kitchen for the first time to showcase their cooking chops for judges Jordan Andino, Lynn Crawford and Anna Olson.

st: This Bread Will Make You Challah
d: Nine junior chefs are in a race to manually whip meringue, then take a fresh approach to serve the judges a specialty lunch box.
The eight remaining junior chefs roll in the dough to make a perfect pasta sheet from scratch then get creative with fresh ravioli.
The junior chefs learn to sizzle with steak in a quest to achieve the perfect medium rare, then take things international with a culinary trip around the world.
The junior chefs pair-up for their first team Skills Test to make a delicious brunch staple, then sweeten things up with chocolatey desserts.
The top five junior chefs are faced with the Mother of all Skills Tests, then play a game of 'Musical Stations' to cook a wok-full of Asian ingredients.
The semi-final sees the top four get creative with cupcakes, then go fish or go home when elevating an English pub classic.
